notes: Slots are intake placeholders, not claims that identical sizes/histories exist at every stack. Never generate a fold or a fake range for missing data. Confirm legal actions and full history separately per source. No active dispatch.
dashboard_policy: Histories are stack-specific. Add exact sequence, parent and edge for each newly mapped stack; do not infer from 25 BB. Dashboard generated from registry. Distinguish RECEIVED_PENDING_EXTRACTION from coded drafts. Record visible tail separately from reconstructed prefix and mark confidence; ambiguous histories must not enter code.
strategy_policy: Pure source estimates first; adjusted variant deferred. No intentional combo changes in reference.
